name: Hau nuong
summary: Hàu nướng is an oyster grilled in the shell, with cheese or with mỡ hành.
howToEat: Eat it hot, off the shell. The two finishes are cheese and mỡ hành.
where: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4. The town streets also serve it.
seoTitle: Hau nuong — grilled oysters at Hang Duong
seoDescription: Hàu nướng is an oyster grilled in the shell, with cheese or with mỡ hành.
